- Core message: The FOMC notes continued labor-market tightening and solid real activity despite hurricane-related disruptions—cyclically positive signals in New Keynesian terms, with anchored expectations implying limited near-term inflation pressure.
- FSR lens: The Financial Stability Report around this period generally highlighted accommodative financial conditions and moderate systemwide vulnerabilities, alongside pockets of elevated asset valuations and rising risk appetite. That mix supports ongoing growth but argues against an overly exuberant read.
- Net take: Constructive macro momentum with tempered risk appetite given valuation pressures and stability considerations; positive but measured.
